processing.orientation: up: reverse native rows; backward: reverse native columns; full DOWN retains rows. Nominal Y=25-(r+.5)*50/240nm; not a calibrated or hard-timestamped laboratory coordinate.
processing.raw: Original physical float32 values; no smoothing, registration, filling or per-line subtraction. Parser row-detrend arrays are not saved or used.
processing.global_plane: One separate full-image plane per F/B, displayed separately; original base plotting routines unchanged.

scope: per-frame descriptive analysis only; actual speed is recorded, comparison type must be selected explicitly
limits: Pixels are not native transient peaks; no range/clipping inference from color or pixel extrema.
BG flags retain legacy descriptors, not automatic pass/fail.
Current/gain/feedback/temperature and continuity require independent root readbacks; header comments may be stale.
A speed change is not a tip-repair intervention; 198 is historical unless separately justified.
